artefacts.title: Stage 4 Technology Mandatory - desk tidy
artefacts.presentationRequirement: Complete PDF download/open route with course context; preserve original bytes
artefacts.permittedFacts: Only the explicitly stated ten-week sequence; orthographic and isometric working-drawing requirement; scale 1:10 orthographic views with dimensions; cutting-list fields for part name, quantity, material and exact dimensions; teacher accuracy check before production; 200 x 20 x 10 mm practice slat; named materials and joints; 80-120-240 grit sequence; one clear water-based varnish coat; and stated functional-test items
artefacts.teacherToConfirm: Actual approved construction drawing, component names and values, completed component schedule, final dimensions, tolerances, approved joint choices and locations, tools and current practical controls
